description: Free with a feed_handle from crypto_feed_subscribe: every published advice change since your cursor, across all covered coins — new signals, classification flips (previous_classification vs classification), status/score/entry-zone changes. Send back next_cursor each time; for the full advice behind a signal_id call get_crypto_signal (paid).

cursor.description: Sequence you last saw; omit to continue from your subscription start, 0 for the backlog

kinds.description: Optional filter: new_signal, classification_changed, status_changed, score_changed, entry_zone_changed, economics_changed, execution_blockers_changed

name: crypto_feed_since

outputSchema.description: Every published change since your cursor, oldest first, across all covered coins — or expired=true when the subscription lapsed.

checked_at.description: When we produced this answer (ISO 8601, UTC). The only ISO timestamp in the payload; every other timestamp is unix seconds.

count.description: Number of events returned after your kinds filter.

cursor.description: The cursor this page started from.

disclaimer.description: Our product boundary, verbatim in every paid advice response: market intelligence only, no execution, no custody, no position sizing, and opportunity_score is a heuristic rather than a calibrated win probability.

items.description: One event = one version row in the upstream publication ledger, oldest first.

at.description: Unix seconds the version was written upstream.

change_types.description: What changed versus the previous version; empty on a version-1 event.

classification.description: Spot-long classification derived from opportunity_score (shorts are never advised). Bands: 80-100 STRONG_LONG, 65-79 LONG, 50-64 CONDITIONAL_LONG, 35-49 SPECULATIVE_LONG (concrete entry setup) or WATCH (no concrete setup, so entry_zone/stop_loss/take_profit are null), below 35 AVOID (actively negative signals) or NEUTRAL. EXIT is a fresh strong exit condition. Candidates with internal execution blockers are capped upstream at CONDITIONAL_LONG.

entry_valid_until.description: Unix seconds until which a NEW entry was advisable at this version.

kinds.description: The filterable kinds derived from this event: new_signal for version 1, otherwise the change_types.

opportunity_score.description: 0-100 heuristic ranking of setup quality (trend alignment, EMA separation, momentum, volume, breakout/pullback strength, efficiency ratio, regime direction, ML horizon scores, estimated net edge, data/spread quality). NOT a calibrated win probability; the measured win rate lives in get_crypto_evidence.

previous_classification.description: Classification of the previous version; null on a brand-new signal. Different from classification = the flip this feed exists for (e.g. NEUTRAL before, CONDITIONAL_LONG now).

publication_status.description: Publication state of the advice. PUBLISHED = live and current, STALE = retrievable history whose entry window closed, INVALIDATED = an invalidation condition triggered. Expired ids stay retrievable with their real status.

score_type.description: Which scheme produced opportunity_score. 'heuristic_v1' is a deterministic, unit-tested heuristic and explicitly signals that the score is not a calibrated probability. Scores are only comparable within one score_type: a 70 of heuristic_v1 says nothing about a 70 of a future heuristic_v2, so any ranking, threshold or history you build resets when this value changes.

seq.description: Ledger sequence of this event; strictly increasing. The cursor you poll with.

signal_id.description: Stable id of the opportunity across versions; the input for every other call in the chain.

version.description: Version of the advice after this event; 1 means a brand-new signal.

expired.description: Present and true when the subscription lapsed; renew via POST /crypto/feed/renew with the same feed_handle.

has_more.description: True when the ledger page was full — poll again immediately rather than waiting.

latest_seq.description: The newest ledger position right now.

next_cursor.description: Send this back on your next poll. Advances over filtered-out events too — a kinds filter never rewinds the cursor.
